What you'll learn
Security teams face increasing volumes of alerts, code, logs, tickets, and threat intelligence, while attackers use AI to make malicious activity faster, more scalable, and more convincing.
In this course, AI-assisted Security for CompTIA SecAI+, you'll gain the ability to apply AI-enabled tools to practical security work, explain how AI enhances attack vectors, and automate repeatable security tasks.
First, you'll explore integrated development environment plug-ins, browser and command-line plug-ins, chatbots, personal assistants, and Model Context Protocol servers. You'll learn how these tools support signature matching, code quality, vulnerability analysis, automated penetration testing, anomaly detection, incident management, threat modeling, fraud detection, translation, and summarization.
Next, you'll discover how AI-generated content, deepfakes, adversarial networks, reconnaissance, social engineering, obfuscation, automated data correlation, and automated attack generation can increase attacker speed, scale, personalization, and effectiveness.
Finally, you'll learn how to automate security tasks using low-code and no-code scripting, document synthesis, incident response ticket management, AI-assisted change management, AI agents, and CI/CD security workflows such as code scanning, software composition analysis, testing, deployment, and rollback.
When you're finished with this course, you'll have the skills and knowledge of AI-assisted security needed to select appropriate AI tools, recognize AI-enhanced threats, automate defensive workflows, and prepare for Domain 3.0 of the CompTIA SecAI+ CY0-001 certification exam.
